reconstruction.method: table-driven: every changed value is read from the delta table, mapped to the r2 proposal field, and the r2 value at that field is checked against the delta's 'from' column

gates.check: low is brand.beige unless declared in lowExceptions
mid is a blend: C ≤ .125 and ΔE ≥ 5 from every energy token + brand.blue
low C 0.04–0.07 (warm lane: C ≤ 0.03), hue within 12° of mid (hue visible, not gray)
mid L = 1.33 − L(light mid) clamp .50–.66 ±.02 (warm lane: L .66 ±.02) · C .05–.12 (±.001 quantisation; warm lane: ≤ .12) · hue within 12° of light mid
high L = 1.30 − L(light high) clamp .78–.90 ±.02 · C ≥ .045 · hue within 15° of light high
ΔE(mid→high) dark ≥ 0.72 × light (compression ≤ 1.4×) — outside the warm lane (D-STEP-03 replaces it there)
warm lane only: every class step ≥ 2.2 ΔE at 5 classes
vs #11191D: low ≤ 2.0:1 · mid vs low ≥ 2.0:1 · high ≥ 7:1
nearest family ΔE(mid)+ΔE(high) ≥ 8 in light AND dark
dark anchors equal the DATAVIZ-03 derivation of the light anchors (hex-exact)
